title: Cohomology of derived pushforward when quasi-coherent higher direct images vanish
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] such that $R^pf_*\mathcal F=0$ for every quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal F$ and every $p>0$, where $R^pf_*$ and $Rf_*:D(\mathcal O_X)\to D(\mathcal O_Y)$ are as in [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. Then for every object $E$ of $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category], not necessarily bounded, and every integer $i$, there is an isomorphism $H^i(Rf_*E)\cong f_*H^i(E)$, natural in $E$.
